[[PAGE 1]]
TERMS OF REFERENCE

Individual Consultant — Mid-Term Evaluation of the Coastal Resilience Programme

United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) — Country Office
Reference No: UNDP-RFP-2026-042

[[PAGE 2]]
1. BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES
The Coastal Resilience Programme supports national adaptation planning. The
objective of this mid-term evaluation is to assess progress against the
results framework of the programme document.

2. KEY INFORMATION
Submission deadline: 12 October 2026
Clarifications must be received by 5 October 2026.
Proposal validity: 90 days from the submission deadline.
Duration: 3 months
Estimated effort: the assignment is estimated at 20 person-days.
Expected start date: 1 November 2026
Contact: procurement.example@undp.org

3. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE
- Master's degree in economics, statistics, international development, or a
  related field.
- At least 7 years of relevant experience in monitoring and evaluation.
- Demonstrated gender-responsive evaluation approaches.
- Experience with UNDP or UNICEF evaluations preferred.
- Excellent report writing and facilitation skills.
Language requirements: excellent written and spoken English is required;
knowledge of French is an asset.

[[PAGE 3]]
4. EVALUATION CRITERIA AND WEIGHTS
Evaluation criteria for the technical proposal (maximum 70 points):
| # | Criterion | Weight |
| 1 | Education: advanced degree in relevant field | 15 |
| 2 | Experience: minimum 7 years in monitoring and evaluation | 30 |
| 3 | Methodology and work plan | 25 |
The financial proposal carries 30 points: lowest-priced compliant offer
receives 30 points.

[[PAGE 4]]
5. DELIVERABLES
- Inception report with evaluation design and work plan
- Data collection instruments and fieldwork completion report
- Final evaluation report addressing all evaluation questions

6. PAYMENT TERMS
Payment terms: 20% upon approval of the inception report; 80% upon acceptance
of the final report.

7. SUBMISSION
Proposals must be submitted via the UNGM e-procurement portal. Bidders must
be registered on UNGM (United Nations Global Marketplace) before award.
No deviation from the General Conditions of Contract is permitted.
